title: credit_notes.validate
description: Validation of a credit-note request: valid, or every error as {field: [codes]} (BE-CN-4, BE-CN-5, BE-CN-12).

errors.description: field -> list of error codes; {} when valid. Eligibility and item errors end the request before the BE-CN-12 checks; the BE-CN-12 checks all run, and a field failing several checks lists their codes in check order (BE-CN-4, BE-CN-5, BE-CN-12).
